shared_elements: low-relief figural scene organized in registers/bands
processional or presentation arrangement of figures facing one direction
figures with detailed patterned garments and headgear
carved surface combining figures with dense script/sign columns (A)
justification: Both show low-relief human figures in strict profile, facing a common direction, laid out along horizontal registers with dividing bands, which is a generic processional convention. A, however, depicts a specific cult scene—a rayed sun-disc whose hand-tipped rays reach a royal couple offering at a laden altar, framed by dense columns of pictorial signs—while B shows only repeated files of similarly dressed figures with no disc, no offering table, and no script, so the distinctive iconography is not shared.
